raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary
- Bump `nvidia-modelopt` from 0.47.0 to 0.48.0rc1 in `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock`.
- Required by #5812.

## Notes
- modelopt 0.48.0rc1 has the same dependency list as 0.47.0, so the `uv.lock` change is limited to the override specifier, package version, and wheel URL/hash. A full `uv lock` (uv 0.7.2) introduced unrelated marker churn on other packages, so the lock was edited surgically; `uv lock --check` passes and the `revision` header is unchanged.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

No verified defects found. The [project override](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/7b520bafccefb852c7b912000dde52dc0b10b560/pyproject.toml#L140), [lockfile override](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/7b520bafccefb852c7b912000dde52dc0b10b560/uv.lock#L32), and [locked package/wheel version](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/7b520bafccefb852c7b912000dde52dc0b10b560/uv.lock#L3060-L3083) consistently select `0.48.0rc1`; the NVIDIA registry and existing dependency edges are preserved.

Static review only: tests and lock/install commands were not executed, and the remote wheel hash and upstream metadata could not be independently verified. Recommended container checks: `uv lock --check` and `uv sync --locked`.

### Suggested test cases
- [`test_collect_modelopt_quant_metadata_skips_unquantized_tasks`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/7b520bafccefb852c7b912000dde52dc0b10b560/tests/unit_tests/models/test_modelopt_utils.py#L199) — retain the NVFP4 metadata and unquantized-task assertions with the new version.
- [`TestQATWorkflow.test_qat_workflow`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/7b520bafccefb852c7b912000dde52dc0b10b560/tests/functional_tests/test_groups/quantization/test_qat_workflow.py#L187), `llama32_1b` — PTQ and training succeed; checkpoint tracker records iteration 10.
- [`TestLlamaDistillRecipes.test_llama_distill_recipes`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/7b520bafccefb852c7b912000dde52dc0b10b560/tests/functional_tests/test_groups/recipes/test_llama_recipes_distill_3b-1b.py#L67), `llama32_3b-1b`, TP=2 — complete ten iterations and verify saved checkpoints.
- No perf tests impacted.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.
